description: Get Lenny Zeltser's expert criteria for reviewing an existing Vulnerability Investigation Brief. Surfaces per-theme review criteria (significance, scope, actions, gaps, sources), cross-cutting criteria, anti-patterns, and inline mcpHandoffs pointers when the requested focus triggers scoring or writing-mechanics themes (e.g., focus=tone surfaces rating_score_writing). This server never requests your vulnerability notes and instructs your AI to keep them local—the brief template and guidelines flow to your AI for local analysis.

focus.description: Focus areas: completeness, clarity, tone, structure, significance, actions, sources, or all.

sections.description: Narrow to specific brief sections; 'all' includes every section.

name: vuln_review_brief
